criteria.title: From a fresh clone on Windows, setup and the full test suite pass
criteria.verify: fresh clone, then `uv sync && uv run playwright install chromium && uv run python tasks.py test`

criteria.title: Fast tests finish quickly
criteria.why: They run after every Claude turn

criteria.title: No personal data or secrets in the repository; the data folder and token files are outside Git
criteria.verify: `uv run pytest tests/test_privacy.py` (scans tracked files for email addresses other than example.com/example.org, tokens, and data/ paths; checks .gitignore)

criteria.title: Every seed file validates against the schema; an invalid file produces an error naming the file and field
No deadline is displayed without its time zone and a source link; unverified data is always visibly marked
Time-zone conversion is correct on the 20 reference cases, including daylight-saving changeovers
criteria.why: A deadline shown an hour or a day off is the costliest error the tool can make

criteria.title: Days-left values match docs/02 §2 on boundary cases
Programme user stories pass end to end (US-1 to US-5 in docs/03 §2)
No serious or critical accessibility violations on any page
criteria.why: WCAG 2.2 AA; keeps the tool usable on a small laptop screen

criteria.title: Dashboard and programme page match the agreed mockup and read clearly
Recommender user stories pass end to end (US-6 to US-9), including a 3,000-character pasted course description saved verbatim
Letter coverage counts and next actions match docs/02 §4 on the fixture set
The sheet stays fast with many professors
criteria.why: The user will have many professors; the sheet must stay a quick glance

criteria.title: Every generated email validates against its JSON schema
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-email` → reports/eval_email.json: schema_failures
criteria.why: The app reads the output by machine

criteria.title: Every eval email names the right professor and course, lists each selected programme with its exact stored deadline, and mentions no unselected programme
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-email` → reports/eval_email.json: fact_failures
criteria.why: A wrong deadline or name in a request to a professor is unrecoverable

criteria.title: Eval emails are 180–280 words, open with 'Dear {title} {surname},' and never state an anticipated achievement as achieved
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-email` → reports/eval_email.json: form_failures
criteria.why: Formal register and honesty about the anticipated cum laude

criteria.title: No unsupported claims in eval emails, and the claim grader flags all 3 planted calibration emails
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-email` → reports/eval_email.json: unsupported_claims, grader_calibration_passed
criteria.why: The user requires accuracy over embellishment

criteria.title: Failure paths (Claude Code missing, timeout, invalid output) show a clear message and write nothing
Five generated emails read as something the user would send
Researching two programmes yields schema-valid files where every filled field has a source URL and the programme is marked unverified
Re-research writes nothing until the user saves; accepted deadline changes reset those deadlines to unverified; rejected changes leave the file byte-identical

On the invented 28-course fixture transcript, course import extracts every course with exact name, grade and credits, flags 0 false grades, stores no identifiers, lists every lecturer once with all their courses, and writes nothing (courses or professors) until the user confirms
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py live -k courses` (tests/evals/courses/) and `uv run pytest tests/test_course_import.py`
criteria.why: Course names and grades go into letters to professors; a wrong grade or a stored student number is unrecoverable

criteria.title: The reminder engine reproduces the worked example and all 30 rows of the golden reminder table
Calendar sync is idempotent: two runs create no duplicates; a changed deadline updates events; resolved reminders are removed (against the fake Google API)
The digest matches its golden file and can only be sent to the owner address in settings
Live smoke test creates, updates and deletes one test event in the Applications calendar
Reminders appear on the iPhone in Apple Calendar with alerts
No code path can send email to any address other than the owner's
The wrong-school check catches all 20 planted mentions with no false positives on 10 clean essays
criteria.why: A competitor's name in an essay is the classic reuse error

criteria.title: Word count matches the rule in docs/02 §7 on all 15 fixtures
Biography, essay, version and CV user stories pass end to end (US-11 to US-14)
Every evaluation validates against its schema and rates all four rubric criteria with a reason
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-essay` → reports/eval_essay.json: schema_failures
criteria.why: The app reads the output by machine

criteria.title: Planted flaws detected in the essay eval set
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-essay` → reports/eval_essay.json: planted_flaws_detected
criteria.baseline: the exact checks alone catch only the word-limit and wrong-school flaws (2 of 10)
criteria.why: Feedback must find real problems, not only restate the draft

criteria.title: The evaluator never rewrites: no comment exceeds 60 words or contains a replacement paragraph
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-essay` → reports/eval_essay.json: rewrite_violations

criteria.title: False alarms on clean essays (accuracy rated weak on a clean essay)
criteria.verify: `uv run python tasks.py eval-essay` → reports/eval_essay.json: clean_essay_false_alarms

criteria.title: Three evaluations of the user's own drafts are useful and fair
The full end-to-end suite passes (US-1 to US-21)
Following README.md alone, the user sets up, syncs and uses the tool
